prompt_en: Create a knee-up 50 mm fashion photograph in a late-night self-service laundromat beside a rain-slick intercity bus terminal. Depict a clearly adult woman with long dark center-parted softly waved hair, warm brown eyes, natural makeup, and a calm expression as an original fictional adult; the attached portrait supplies only these visible appearance cues. She transfers a folded striped shirt from a chrome dryer into a clear jelly tote. Her charcoal satin camisole has ivory floral attached lace trim at neckline and lower hem above washed wide-leg denim. A smooth base-garment edge remains visibly different from the lace along the satin camisole neckline; one narrow lace band follows a neckline cuff or hem edge across the upper chest; real open cells and repeating thread motifs remain visible in the lace at native detail; a stitched attachment line and scalloped free edge remain separately readable along the neckline; the material boundary distinguishes attached trim from printed lace and whole-lace fabric at the stitched neckline edge. The lower hem repeats the openwork scallops. A frontal torso angle and directional fluorescent light keep both edges crisp. Chrome dryer circles and thin amber bus-light trails stretch behind a flash-frozen sharp torso, adding depth behind the lace.
